sections.heading: TOP FINDING - read before trusting any shadow verdict

fields.label: Single-boot verdicts are unreliable
fields.value: The lane produces transient windows of CONSECUTIVE failing boots. Measured: failures at positions 4-5-6 and 15-16-17 of 24, no position trend, and 6 of 8 were in SSE2 TUs vs 2 in x87 TUs - so the window is not a property of the row OR the build.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Require TWO independent boots before recording a CRASH/VOID/NO_SAMPLES or attributing it to a change.

fields.label: Cause
fields.value: UNKNOWN - top open question. Ruled out: long-run degradation, group interference, build variant.

fields.label: 8 results rows annotated
fields.value: as failure-window artefacts, with their prior verdicts inline

fields.label: D-11070 float model
fields.value: DECIDED: per-TU /arch:IA32 on 4 measured TUs (build_objs.ps1 -X87List + x87_tus.txt, both targets). The build was SSE2, not x87. A 10-TU trial did NOT generalise, so it was narrowed to what repeats: 4 DIVERGENT->CLEAN conversions seen twice each.

fields.label: 0x0056f350
fields.value: CLOSED: port defect was a Ghidra-interleaving spill (fixed, spill cmov gone from codegen, control 3/3 RACE_OK). Residual crash is inherited witness invalidity - it calls FUN_0056f0a0. Out of the lane, stays C2.
